changes: Rewrote /agent/solver.md into a stricter step-by-step workflow. The main failure was submitting right after a sample check or before any check at all: lcb-3655 never ran tests, and lcb-arc183-c checked only two small samples and then submitted an O(N^3) numpy solution that timed out. The new prompt requires checking the rule against sample explanations, estimating operation counts for max-size inputs, running all samples, comparing against a brute force on small random cases, timing a max-size input, and only then submitting. It is a gate, not a suggestion. One trial on lcb-3655 still failed (wrong answer). The agent passed the samples but skipped the brute-force and timing checks, which prompted the stronger gate. I did not re-trial after that last edit, and the trial hit a 429 rate-limit error, so the effect is unverified. validate() reports OK.
